atAGlance: Bánh bao xá xíu is a steamed bun filled with sweet-savory barbecue pork. The soft dough and saucy pork are the appeal.
whatItIs: Bánh bao xá xíu is a soft steamed bun filled with sweet-salty barbecue pork.
howToEnjoy: Eat warm while the dough is soft. If pork is a no, choose bánh bao chay instead.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh bao xá xíu when you want the barbecue pork steamed-bun version. Ask whether it has egg inside if you care about the filling.
worthKnowing: Xá xíu reflects Chinese-Vietnamese roast-pork flavor inside a Vietnamese snack-counter bun.
goodToKnow: Xá xíu means char siu-style pork. This is a pork bun, not a crisp baguette sandwich.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một cái bánh bao xá xíu.
orderLine.english: I’d like one char siu steamed bun.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht kai bahn bow sah see-ew
